sar.narrative: Customer C09988, using card C09988-K1, was associated with suspicious transactions 3534820 between 2016-12-11 and 2016-12-11. The transactions were for $59.67, totaling $59.67. They occurred through the online channel and were identified as card not present new device activity. The cardholder denied the flagged purchase where customer confirmation was available. The activity used device profile windows | unknown | edge 16.0 | unknown, which also appears on confirmed closed fraud cases. Graph traversal and prior-case retrieval showed that the activity was not adequately explained by the risk score alone. The institution opened an internal case and preserved the supporting transaction and relationship evidence. Protective action and monitoring were recommended under the supplied fraud policy.
